description: Angular component for configuring a pie chart widget in the Thingsboard platform, including default data keys, settings, and form controls.

classes.name: PieChartBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending LatestChartBasicConfigComponent to configure pie chart widget settings.

methods.name: defaultDataKeys
methods.description: Provides default data keys for the pie chart, including wind, solar, and hydroelectric power.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the pie chart widget.

methods.name: latestChartConfigTemplate
methods.description: Returns the template reference for the latest chart configuration.

methods.name: setupLatestChartControls
methods.description: Sets up form controls for chart display options such as labels, border, radius, and direction.

methods.name: prepareOutputLatestChartConfig
methods.description: Prepares and applies the latest chart configuration settings to the widget config.

methods.name: latestChartValidatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation when changed.

methods.name: updateLatestChartValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables label-related controls based on the showLabel toggle.
